# SolidCraft Command Map

Command ids are the dotted names SolidCraft uses in its command palette and in
scripts. This is a working map of the ones used in the book, grouped by task.
Parameters change between versions; ask the installed version for the current
schema before scripting.

```bash
# List every command in the installed version, with one-line parameter docs
solidcraft-cli commands
```

With an assistant connected to SolidCraft, `describe_command` gives the JSON
schema for commands that have a typed contract.

## Design and file

| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `file.new` | Start a new design |
| `file.save` | Save the current design |
| `file.save_as` | Save under a new name |
| `document.units` | Change display units (`mm`, `cm`, `m`, `in`, `ft`) |

Opening an existing design, saving a copy, and taking screenshots are also
available as assistant tools; not every one is a command id.

## Sketching

| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `sketch.create` | Start a sketch on a plane or face |
| `sketch.line` | Draw connected line segments |
| `sketch.rectangle.two_point` | Rectangle from opposite corners |
| `sketch.rectangle.center` | Rectangle from a centre |
| `sketch.circle.center` | Circle from centre and radius |
| `sketch.arc.three_point` | Arc through three points |
| `sketch.dimension` | Add a driving dimension |
| `sketch.constraint.horizontal_vertical` | Horizontal/vertical constraint |
| `sketch.constraint.coincident` | Join two points |
| `sketch.constraint.parallel` | Parallel constraint |
| `sketch.constraint.perpendicular` | Perpendicular constraint |
| `sketch.constraint.equal` | Equal length or radius |
| `sketch.constraint.midpoint` | Point at a midpoint |
| `sketch.constraint.symmetry` | Symmetry constraint |
| `sketch.toggle_driven` | Switch a dimension between driving and driven |
| `sketch.loose_ends` | Find open ends in a sketch |
| `sketch.finish` | Finish the sketch and return to the solid tools |

The full constraint family is `sketch.constraint.*`; use `solidcraft-cli
commands` to see the current list.

## Solids

| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `solid.extrude` | Push a profile into a solid |
| `solid.revolve` | Revolve a profile around an axis |
| `solid.sweep` | Sweep a profile along a path |
| `solid.loft` | Blend between profiles |
| `solid.box` | Primitive box |
| `solid.cylinder` | Primitive cylinder |
| `solid.hole` | Standard hole, counterbore, or countersink |
| `solid.fillet` | Round an edge |
| `solid.chamfer` | Cut a flat corner |
| `solid.combine` | Boolean union, cut, or intersect |
| `solid.mirror` | Mirror bodies or features |
| `solid.pattern.rectangular` | Repeat in a grid |
| `solid.pattern.circular` | Repeat around an axis |
| `solid.pattern.path` | Repeat along a path |

## Components and assemblies

| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `component.create` | Create a component |
| `component.from_bodies` | Turn existing bodies into a component |
| `component.activate` | Make a component active for editing |
| `component.copies` | Place multiple occurrences |
| `component.capture_position` | Record an occurrence's position |
| `assembly.bom` | Bill of materials for the assembly |
| `joint.create` | Create an assembly joint |
| `joint.inspect` | Inspect a joint |

## Measure, check, and document

| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `inspect.measure` | Measure a body or selection |
| `inspect.clearance` | Find near contacts and overlaps |
| `inspect.interference` | Check for interference |
| `inspect.section` | Cut a section through the model |
| `view.save` | Save a named view |
| `view.apply` | Restore a saved view |
| `view.isometric` | Standard isometric view |
| `file.export` | Export bodies to STEP, 3MF, STL, or OBJ |
| `file.export_view_dxf` | Export a view to DXF |

## If you drive SolidCraft from an assistant

The assistant tools wrap the same operations and add a few conveniences:

| Tool | Use |
|------|-----|
| `batch` | Run a sequence of commands as one all-or-nothing step |
| `screenshot` | Render a PNG, optionally to a file path |
| `inspect_design` | Read the whole design: timeline, bodies, sketches, warnings |
| `measure` | Measure bodies or selections |
| `body_topology` | List faces, edges, and usable selection points |
| `set_parameter` | Change a parameter and rebuild |
| `skill_reference` | Read SolidCraft's bundled modeling guidance |

When a batch fails, it rolls back the steps it already ran. Read the failing
step and its error before retrying; do not resend a timed-out request that is
still running.

## FreeCAD

FreeCAD has no equivalent JSON command map. Its automation surface is the Python
API, with macros, the Python console, and `freecadcmd` for headless runs. See
Part IV for the modeling workflow and Appendix E for the MCP setup.
